Job description




Job Title: Head of Engineering / Full Stack Developer (MERN Stack)

Location: Gurgaon (Work from Office Only)

Experience: 2-4+ Years




Role Overview




We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Full Stack Developer (MERN Stack) to lead our engineering function as Head of Department (HOD). The candidate will be responsible for building scalable applications, driving backend architecture, and leading a team to deliver high-quality products.




Key Responsibilities




Technical Leadership

Lead development using MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)
Drive end-to-end development of new applications from design to deployment
Handle server-side development, API creation, and integrations
Design and implement microservices architecture for scalable and robust systems
Ensure best practices in coding, testing, and performance optimization

DevOps & CI/CD

Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for continuous integration and deployment
Automate build, testing, and release processes
Ensure high availability, monitoring, and system performance

Team Management & Leadership

Lead and manage a team of developers
Act as Head of Department (HOD) for the engineering team
Mentor team members and drive performance excellence
Implement agile practices and ensure timely delivery of projects

Strategic Role

Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, Business, Design)
Drive architecture decisions and long-term technology roadmap
Align engineering deliverables with business goals



Required Skills & Qualifications



Strong expertise in MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)
Hands-on experience in building and scaling new applications
Strong understanding of microservices architecture
Experience in server-side development and REST APIs
Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes)
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP preferred)
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

Leadership & Soft Skills

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Strong ownership mindset and leadership capabilities
Ability to manage teams and stakeholders effectively



Work Conditions



Work from Office (WFO) Mandatory
Location: Gurgaon
